topic: OpenAI expands the Agents API with computer use and GPT-6.1 Sol
caption:
OpenAI's latest developer update is much bigger than a model refresh.

GPT-6.1 Sol is now available for complex coding and professional work, while the Agents API can now use an OpenAI-hosted browser for computer-use tasks. OpenAI also added Multi-agent support in beta, allowing a model to delegate work to subagents inside a Responses API request.

The interesting part for developers is the direction: agents are moving from generating answers toward executing multi-step work across browsers, tools, and specialized subagents.

That changes how we should think about AI application architecture — less single-prompt automation, more orchestration, permissions, observability, and reliable handoffs between agents and humans.

Source: OpenAI API Changelog
